narrative.overview:
MixMusic is a wall of type and colour on true black. Every place in the player names itself in one giant, light, lowercase word that fills the width of the pane and is never cut; beneath it, a row of pivot words names the page's sections. Music sits on flat fields of colour (cyan, magenta, lime, amber) and on square artwork, never on rounded cards floating over charcoal. The interface is drawn almost entirely in white ink at light weights, with a single live colour that floods whatever is current.

Density is that of a tool kept open for hours: a 248px rail of outlined icon boxes, a main pane of giant words, tiles and shelves, a 340px queue column that always shows what plays next, and a 92px player bar. The pane is scrolled, the shell never is. Motion is short and directional: pages swing in from the right like a turnstile, pressed tiles tilt toward the pointer, the live tile in the rail flips over to show the next track.

The system is a public contract. Every colour, face, radius and measure is a `--mm-*` variable that a theme sets, and the `mm-*` class hooks and root attributes listed in `docs/themes.md` are stable. The default theme (Mix) is the reference expression; Daylight, Midnight, Sakura, Terminal, Aurora, Greenroom, Glasshouse, Anime and Mochi are token variants of the same grammar (light ground, other accents, other radii, other faces), not separate designs.
keyCharacteristics: Giant lowercase light-weight words as the primary navigation landmark, shrunk to fit the pane, never cropped.
Flat colour tiles with ink in `tile-text`; texture printed only inside tiles.
One live colour (the accent, or the artwork's colour when dynamic) for every current, selected or playing thing, applied as a flood.
Secondary controls are 2px white outlines; pressing inverts them to solid ink.
Square corners by default; circles only for transport, artist portraits and stats.
Where a track comes from is a mark with a shape, not just a colour.

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Only the accent marks what is current, selected or playing, and it marks it by flooding the whole row, box or chip with the accent and switching the ink to accent ink. No second highlight colour, no tinted half-states for selection.

rules.name: The Source Tag Rule
rules.body: The service colours exist only to tag where a track comes from. They never become an accent, a fill or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Page words, pivots, tile titles, section titles and nav labels are lowercase. Names of tracks, artists, albums and services keep their own capitalisation.

rules.name: The Light At Size Rule
rules.body: Everything at subtitle size and above is weight 300 with negative tracking (from -0.02em at pivots to -0.045em at the page word). Weight 600 appears only on the action inside a toast.

rules.name: The Flat Tile Rule
rules.body: A tile is a flat field of one tile colour. No gradient fill, bevel, or shadow, ever. A tile may carry its theme's printed texture in the lower corner and, on the home page, a faint luminosity print of artwork faded out under its words, so the ink always sits on the tile's colour.

rules.name: The Floating Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to things that float above the window (menus, toasts). Anything that sits in the layout stays flat.

rules.name: The Reading Size Rule
rules.body: On the site, reading copy steps up one size from the app (body 1.0625rem, leads at weight 300 from 1.5 to 2.125rem with 1.12 to 1.18 leading); everything at lead size and above stays weight 300 with negative tracking, as the Light At Size Rule says.

dos: **Do** open every page with its name in one lowercase display word, weight 300, letting it run past the pane's right edge.
**Do** mark every current, selected or playing thing by flooding it with the accent and switching to accent ink.
**Do** draw secondary buttons, inputs, chips and nav boxes as 2px outlines in `--mm-outline`, inverting to solid ink when pressed.
**Do** put destinations on flat tiles in the four tile tones, with lowercase light titles in tile ink.
**Do** tag every track with its source mark, a shape first and a colour second.
**Do** take every colour, face, radius, size and measure from a `--mm-*` variable, and style through the hooks and attributes in `docs/themes.md` without renaming them.
**Do** keep the next track in view: the queue column, the player bar's "next" line and the live tile's back face.
**Do** let the site's player bar play the page: its progress is the scroll position, its title the section in view, and its primary action is always the download.
donts: **Don't** fill a tile with a gradient, or give tiles, artwork, rows or panels a shadow or bevel; shadows are for menus and toasts only.
**Don't** introduce a second highlight colour; the service colours tag sources and nothing else.
**Don't** set display, pivot, title or tile type in a heavy weight, or capitalise page words, pivots and tile titles.
**Don't** round corners with a literal value; corners come from `--mm-radius` and `--mm-radius-sm`, and circles are reserved for transport, play buttons, artists and stats.
**Don't** crop or ellipsis-truncate the page word or the pivots; they shrink to fit the pane, then wrap.
